integrity.computational_evidence: self-contained direct group operations and finite-field enumeration in verify_word_joint.py

scientific_limitations: Covers UT_4 over finite fields, not arbitrary finite groups or higher unitriangular ranks.
The central commutator polynomial is already implicit in Gritschacher--Villarreal Lemma 4.2; novelty concerns exact word-value counts, joint cube law and characteristic-three conditional uniformity.
An implicit equivalent counting result in older word-map literature cannot be definitively excluded.
Only the abstract of Rostamyari--Moghaddam--Khoshtarash (2022) was accessible; possible stronger overlap in full text is unresolved.
source_ids: Erfanian--Farrokhi, International Journal of Group Theory 2(4) (2013), 31--38
title: Joint cube–2-Engel word laws for four-by-four unitriangular groups over finite fields
